answer: Each identity carries one walnut: a sealed bundle of its own verified jobs, openable only by its own key, never lent or split. A claim is posted on a knoll, a public rise visible for one full epoch while any peer may crack the walnut and check it; leaving the knoll early voids the claim. The claim counts only at a vertex: a point where three unrelated peer records meet and corroborate one history; a claim with no vertex is ignored outright. A hollow walnut, one whose contents do not match its seal, drops the claim and seals the bundle shut; ten voices need ten bundles and ten climbs.
